notes.title: Hotfix 1.09
notes.content:
[b]Our latest Hotfix 1.09 is now live.[/b]

The following fix applies to both PSVR2 and PCVR:
[list]
[*] Addresses crashing issues related to previous saves introduced in patch 1.08
[/list]

Thank you for your patience, and thank you to the community members who let us know where patch 1.08 was falling short of expectations. Thanks to you and the information you provided, we were able to address this quickly. We encourage all players to keep engaging with us and letting us know how your experience with Alien: Rogue Incursion is unfolding, as making Alien: Rogue Incursion the best way to experience Alien continues to be our goal.

notes.title: Patch 1.08
notes.content:
Hello to Our Valued Community,

Our latest Patch 1.08 is now live.

The following fixes apply to both PSVR2 and PCVR SKUs except where specified. (Please Note: Reporting some of these fixes may reveal elements that occur later in the story): 

[list]
[*] [b]Major Xenomorph spawning rebalance.[/b] The Xenomorph’s hearing and vision were adjusted to avoid spawning in overwhelming numbers and too accurate awareness of the player’s location.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game reloaded with the fuel cell under the floor and was unreachable.
[*] Fixes for missing or incorrect objective map markers on the tablet’s map.
[*] The achievement for reading all the messages has been fixed. 
[*] The achievement for solving power boxes has been fixed. 
[*] Fix for saves during airlock quarantines causing the player being stuck in either airlock in medical.
[*] The support grip for the pulse rifle and shotgun are now easier to grab.
[*] Addressed areas in the crash site where collision issues caused some players to become stuck. 
[*] Tuned Xenomorph taunt duration and open mouth vulnerability to be shorter on harder difficulties
[*] Davis no longer randomly looks away from the player during the catwalk scene on ship
[*] Players are no longer able to lock themselves in closets or airlocks
[*] Synths are no longer visible on the motion tracker after being killed
[*] Fix for fire collision in mess hall still being active if the player dies after extinguishing it
[*] Fix for unfinished welds disappearing after reloading a save.
[*] Increased explosive barrel damage radius 
[*] Fix for xenomorphs getting stuck behind closed shutters.
[*] Fix for cargo containers missing door access panels
[*] Fixed intermittent jamming of the revolver upon ejecting the cylinder  
[*] Fixed revolver jamming intermittently while finishing a reload
[*] Adjusted flashlight angle
[*] Crashes and lots of smaller fixes
[/list]

In response to player feedback, we are introducing the following new feature to enhance the gameplay experience.

New Gameplay Options:
[list]
[*] Support for save history.  This gives players the ability to load previous saves.
[/list]

Lastly, if you’re experiencing any issues or have feedback, please check out our [url=https://survios.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/categories/36540434941971-ALIEN-ROGUE-INCURSION]FAQ[/url] first. If you still can’t find a solution, feel free to reach out to us at [url=support@survios.com]support@survios.com[/url], and we’ll assist you directly.

Thank you for your continued support and patience!
Survios

notes.title: Alien: Rogue Incursion - Game Updates
notes.content:
Hello to Our Valued Community,

Since the launch of Alien: Rogue Incursion, the Survios team has been genuinely excited by the enthusiasm and passion players have shown for our game. Seeing so many of you join us on this journey has been humbling and incredibly rewarding, but our work is not done. We’re actively listening to your feedback and are dedicated to continuously improving the game. 

Our team is currently working to resolve some of the concerns discussed within the community. We plan to implement these fixes in-game as soon as they meet our quality standards. Here is an overview of some of what will be addressed in our next patch:

[b]XENOMORPH SPAWN DISTRIBUTION[/b]
○	[i]Frequency of spawn
○	Response to threats & noise
○	Time to kill[/i]
[b]MULTIPLE SAVES PER SLOT[/b]
[b]ACHIEVEMENTS FOR MESSAGES AND POWER BOXES[/b]

We’ve also already released several hotfixes since the launch of Alien: Rogue Incursion. [strike]Before downloading the upcoming patch, make sure you've updated your game with the latest hotfix: [/strike]
Details on everything fixed so far can be found in the patch notes below:

●	[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1850050/view/520826430987174045?l=english]Hotfix 1.04.1[/url]
●	[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1850050/view/520826430987174757?l=english]Hotfix 1.05[/url]
●	[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1850050/view/536590314007167295?l=english]Hotfix 1.06[/url]
●	[url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1850050/view/536590767160820462?l=english]Hotfix 1.07[/url]

[b]Note:[/b] These hotfixes are automatically downloaded by Steam, so no further action is required to play the latest version of the game.

We will continue posting patch notes here and on our [url=https://survios.com/studio/news-press/]website[/url] as new builds go live. We also invite you to join the official [url=https://discord.gg/survios]Survios Discord Server[/url] to stay up to date with the latest news and announcements.

Now is the time to step into the universe of the Alien films in the most terrifyingly immersive single-player VR experience: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1850050/Alien_Rogue_Incursion/

Lastly, if you’re experiencing any issues or have feedback, please check out our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fsurvios.zendesk.com%2Fhc%2Fen-us%2Fcategories%2F36540434941971-ALIEN-ROGUE-INCURSION]FAQ[/url] first. If you still can’t find a solution, contact us at [url=support@survios.com]support@survios.com[/url], and we’ll assist you directly.

Thank you for your continued support and patience!
Survios

notes.title: Hotfix 1.07
notes.content:
Hello to Our Valued Community,

Our latest Hotfix 1.07 is now live.

Fixes include (Please Note: Reporting some of these fixes may reveal elements that occur later in the story): 
[list]
[*] The fuel cell will now return to the player if it ever drops out of the world.
[*] Fixed an intermittent issue of the wheellock falling through the floor when grabbed.
[*] Addressed a chance of the tablet becoming invisible and disappearing from the utility wheel.
[*] GES hard drives now properly restore their state when loading from save game.
[/list]
In response to player feedback, we are introducing several new settings to enhance the gameplay experience.

New Gameplay Options:
[list]
[*] Interaction Weight: Players can now disable the simulated weight of held objects to maintain precise 1:1 hand control.
[*] Motion Tracker Warning Ping: The warning ping when the motion tracker is holstered can now be toggled on/off.
[*] Grip Type: Select the “toggle” option to avoid holding the grip button down continuously to maintain a hold on objects.
[*] Arm Sway: Disable visual movement feedback of arm bobbing during joystick motion.
[/list]
Lastly, if you’re experiencing any issues or have feedback, please check out our [url=https://survios.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/categories/36540434941971-ALIEN-ROGUE-INCURSION]FAQ[/url] first. If you still can’t find a solution, feel free to reach out to us at support@survios.com, and we’ll assist you directly.

Thank you for your continued support and patience!
Survios

notes.title: Hotfix 1.05
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We just pushed Hotfix 1.05 live.

Fixes include (Please Note: Reporting some of these fixes may reveal elements that occur later in the story): 
[list]
[*] Fuel rods now properly restore their state when loading from a save which avoids a progression blocker.
[*] Removed an exploit that allowed the player to be invulnerable to Xeno attacks in a corner of the Mess Hall.
[*] The objective map marker for the first junction power box goes away once it is solved.
[*] Return to ship objective map markers appear in the correct place.
[*] Romulus and Camo skins for the rifle appear correctly.
[*] Tuning of Valve Index controller grab thresholds for a more comfortable experience that requires less effort to grab and less chance of an unintended release of an item.
[*] Instanced Stereo Rendering enabled on PC - this gives about a 10% of performance to the game when it is CPU bound.
[*] Dynamic resolution is set to On when resetting graphics settings.
[*] Dynamic resolution has an option for 80 fps as target frame rate.
[/list]

In addition, in order to mitigate confusion and technical issues, we have updated the compatibility warning popup in the game on launch:
[list]
[*] If the user is using Virtual Desktop with SteamVR run time, the game now prompts the user to quit the game and set VDXR as the OpenXR Runtime in your Virtual Desktop Streamer option.
[*] If no headset is detected, the user is prompted to quit the game and set OpenXR Runtime is set in the SteamVR Settings or the Meta Quest Link Settings.
[/list]

As a reminder, if you are using Oculus Rift or Meta Quest, the officially supported means of connection are:
[list]
[*] Meta Quest Link App, set set as the default OpenXR run time.
[*] Virtual Desktop, with VDXR set as the OpenXR run time.
[/list]

Using another means of connection for Oculus Rift or Meta Quest, such as using SteamVR as the OpenXR run time, will result in bad performance and loss of menu button.

Lastly, if you’re experiencing any issues or have feedback, please check out our [url=https://survios.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/categories/36540434941971-ALIEN-ROGUE-INCURSION]FAQ[/url] first. If you still can’t find a solution, feel free to reach out to us at support@survios.com, and we’ll assist you directly.

Thank you for your patience!
Survios

notes.title: A Message to Our Valued Community
notes.content:
To our valued community,
 
We have recently received a lot of feedback about the inclusion of “Part One” in Alien: Rogue Incursion’s opening moments, within the achievement/trophy list, and store pages.
 
Never did we intend to mislead or cause confusion about what this game is, and we now understand how the addition of “Part One” could be interpreted.
 
Part One is a standalone adventure which ends with a cliffhanger, and we wanted fans to know that there would be more on the horizon, so we decided to confirm Part Two alongside the launch. The entire team at Survios are fans of the Alien universe, and cannot wait to tell more stories about Zula, Davis, and others.
 
While we have nothing to announce about Part Two, beyond that it is actively in development, we promise to share more exciting updates at a later date.
 
We appreciate the excitement and passion you have shown towards Alien: Rogue Incursion, and hope that you enjoy exploring Purdan and Castor’s Cradle as much as we enjoyed creating it.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.04.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We just pushed Hotfix 1.04.1 live.

Fixes include ([b]Please Note:[/b] Reporting some of these fixes may reveal elements that occur later in the story): 
[list]
[*] The map waypoint marker now correctly points to the fuel cell outside the ship.
[*] Xenomorph no longer attempts to crawl through closed shutters in OPS.
[*] Objective marker points to Helen correctly when you get to Medical.
[*] Helen’s legs no longer unnaturally move sideways during a cinematic in Medical
[*] Changing Visual Effects graphics option no longer causes hats to lose collision permanently and prevents players from ever putting on a hat
[*] Lowered the rifle recoil while aiming down sight state when ADS assist is disabled.
[*] Fixed a bug where Nest Core Xenos were not despawning.
[*] Tuning body slot grab zones to mitigate accidental grabbing of wrong items
[*] Adjusted the prop that the quest marker points to for the Ship Fuel Cell, so the marker now correctly appears outside the ship on the map instead of inside.
[*] The spectator screen renders properly when dynamic resolution is enabled.
[*] Addressed an instance of a rare crash upon loading the game.
[/list]

In addition, we’ve heard your feedback regarding compatibility issues with Virtual Desktop and have implemented the following:
[list]
[*] Fixed Virtual Desktop VDXR from no longer breaking head tracking. The user's view will no longer experience unplayable judder when using VDXR as the OpenXR Runtime option in the Virtual Desktop Streamer App. 
[*] [b]Note:[/b] We recommend you set VDXR as the OpenXR Runtime in your Virtual Desktop Streamer option so that the game can respond to the menu button to pause.
[/list]

Lastly, if you’re experiencing any issues or have feedback, please check out our [url=https://survios.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/categories/36540434941971-ALIEN-ROGUE-INCURSION]FAQ[/url] first. If you still can’t find a solution, feel free to reach out to us at support@survios.com, and we’ll assist you directly.

Thank you for your patience!
Survios

notes.title: Alien: Rogue Incursion (PC VR) Review
notes.content:
Alien: Rogue Incursion finally brings the beloved franchise into VR, giving fans the opportunity to experience the tense atmosphere and action the series is known for in a whole new way. As someone who enjoys VR, I’ve already played both Alien: Isolation and Aliens: Fireteam Elite in virtual reality, thanks to the efforts of the modding community. This left me very curious about how good Alien: Rogue Incursion could be, as it is a game built from the ground up with VR in mind.

Thankfully, for the most part, Alien: Rogue Incursion sticks the landing like a Xenomorph on the outside of a spaceship. The roughly 10-hour adventure places players into the shoes of one Zula Hendricks, a tough-as-nails ex-Colonial Marine, alongside her synth partner on a mission to uncover the secrets of a brand new facility on the planet Purdan.
